name: Gravita India Ltd.
about: Gravita India Limited manufactures and recycles lead metal, lead products, aluminium alloys, and plastic granules in India and internationally. It operates through Lead Processing, Aluminium Processing, Turn-Key Solutions, Plastic Manufacturing, and Copper Alloys and Strips Processing segments. The company engages in smelting of lead battery scrap/lead concentrate to produce secondary lead metal, such as pure lead, specific lead alloy, lead oxides, and lead sheets, lead powder, lead shot, etc.; trading of taint tabor and tense aluminium scraps; and manufacturing of alloy from melting of aluminium scrap. verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: Price implies only ~17% a year growth, below the ~23% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 27 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 38), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 27 vs sector median 17; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 18, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
